 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs/task-845e17ff.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find monochrome 4-connected objects, ordered by their original columns.
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            minr = min(y for y,x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y,x in cells)
            shape = [(y-minr,x-minc) for y,x in cells]
            sh = max(y for y,x in shape)+1
            sw = max(x for y,x in shape)+1
            objects.append((minc, color, shape, sh, sw))
    objects.sort(key=lambda o: o[0])
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    top = left = 0
    for i, (_, color, shape, sh, sw) in enumerate(objects):
        for dy, dx in shape:
            y, x = top+dy, left+dx
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = color
        top += sh - 1
        left += sw - 1
    return out
"
}
